chunks: There came a man running from the other part of the city. "O Moses," he said, "the chiefs are deliberating to kill you. Go away from the city. I wish you well."
ai.seo_question: Who warned Prophet Moses to leave the city and why?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the role of a faithful believer from outside the elite circle who warns Prophet Moses (AS) of the conspiracies by the chiefs. In Shia exegesis, this event underscores the importance of timely advice (nasihah) and divine protection through intermediaries, occurring just before Moses' flight to Midian. The man's urgency reflects the critical moment of transition in Moses' prophetic mission.
